jobs.title: Full Stack Web Developer
jobs.descriptionText:
Fullstack Web Developer InternCompany: RecruitPoolzLocation: RemoteDuration: Up to 6 monthsBatch Start Date: 20th AugustAbout the ProgramAt RecruitPoolz, we're doing things differently. This isn't a traditional job or a standard internship—it’s an open collaboration program designed for aspiring fullstack web developers to gain hands-on, real-world experience. If you are self-taught, a boot-camp graduate, a student, or transitioning careers, this is a space for you to write actual production code, connect the frontend with the backend, build your portfolio, and learn by doing alongside our team.What You’ll Do      End-to-End Development: Build responsive user interfaces on the frontend and connect them seamlessly to server-side logic and databases on the backend.API Design & Integration: Create, maintain, and consume robust RESTful or GraphQL APIs to ensure smooth data communication across the stack.Database Management: Design database schemas, write efficient queries, and ensure efficient, secure storage of application data.Collaborate & Deploy: Use Git and GitHub to manage version control, participate in collaborative code reviews, and assist in deploying updates to live environments.
Who You Are      Passionate about full-stack engineering and eager to learn (no specific computer science degree required).Comfortable writing code on both sides of the stack (e.g., HTML/CSS/JavaScript for frontend; Node.js, Python, or Java for backend).Familiar with relational or non-relational databases (such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB).Bonus points: If you have built projects using modern stacks (like MERN, PERN, or Django+React), understand authentication patterns, or have deployed a live application to AWS, Vercel, or Render.Curious, driven, and comfortable asking questions.
What You Get      Remote & Flexible: Contribute from anywhere, on a schedule that works for you.Real Portfolio Projects: Leave with fully functional, end-to-end web applications running live in production to show future employers, stepping far beyond basic tutorials.Direct Mentorship: Get honest code reviews, architectural feedback, and technical guidance from our core engineering team.Proof of Impact: A certificate of completion and a strong letter of recommendation for active contributors.
Application Deadline: 16th August. Fill the form and join our WhatsApp community for the joining process.

jobs.title: Back End Developer
jobs.descriptionText:
Backend Developer InternCompany: Uni.AiHUbLocation: RemoteDuration: Up to 6 monthsBatch Start Date: 20 AugustAbout the ProgramAt Uni.AiHUb, we're doing things differently. This isn't a traditional job or a standard internship—it’s an open collaboration program designed for aspiring backend developers to gain hands-on, real-world experience. If you are self-taught, a boot-camp graduate, a student, or transitioning careers, this is a space for you to write actual production code, build your portfolio, and learn by doing alongside our team.What You’ll Do      Build APIs & Architecture: Design, develop, and maintain robust RESTful APIs and server-side logic to power web applications.Manage Databases: Set up and manage databases, write efficient queries, and ensure data security and integrity.Debug & Optimise: Troubleshoot server-side issues, fix bugs, and optimize application performance and scalability.Collaborate on Code: Use Git and GitHub to manage version control, push backend updates, and participate in code reviews with the team.
Who You Are      Passionate about backend development and eager to learn (no specific computer science degree required).Solid grasp of at least one server-side programming language (such as Node.js, Python, Java, or PHP).Familiar with the basics of relational (SQL) or non-relational (NoSQL) databases.Bonus points: If you have hands-on experience with backend frameworks (like Express, Django, or Spring Boot), API testing tools like Postman, or basic cloud deployment.Curious, driven, and comfortable asking questions.
What You Get      Remote & Flexible: Contribute from anywhere, on a schedule that works for you.Real Portfolio Projects: Leave with functional APIs, well-structured database schemas, and scalable backend systems to show future employers, stepping beyond standard tutorials.Direct Mentorship: Get honest code reviews, architectural feedback, and guidance from our core development team.Proof of Impact: A certificate of completion and a strong letter of recommendation for active contributors.
Application Deadline: 16th August. Fill the form and join our WhatsApp community for the joining process.

jobs.descriptionText: About the CompanyZeTheta Algorithms Private Limited is a FinTech start-up which has been recently set up and is developing innovative AI tools. https://www.instagram.com/zetheta.officialAbout the RoleThe Full Stack Engineer Intern will be responsible for developing the online platforms which shall include frontend, backend, APIs, and data processing logic. This includes wireframing, building the website's home page, password authentication, dashboards post login, and AI features integration. Extensive model building with algorithms is involved.ResponsibilitiesDevelop responsive web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and PHP. Develop interactive UI using React.js with Tailwind CSS or alternatives such as Vue.js and Angular. Design UI for multiple AI features. Utilize UI libraries like Bootstrap or Material UI for styling. Design, build, and implement secure RESTful APIs using Node.js with Express.js. Implement authentication systems using Firebase free tier or PostgreSQL with Supabase. Store and retrieve intern, employer, and job data on MongoDB Atlas (free tier). Connect APIs with the frontend and collaborate with team members to integrate frontend components with server-side logic. Develop a blockchain-based certificate verification system. Develop and maintain server-side applications using frameworks such as Django, Flask, Express (Node.js), Rails (Ruby), Spring (Java), or Laravel (PHP). Troubleshoot and optimize backend performance.QualificationsBasic proficiency in one or more backend frameworks. Strong programming skills in HTML, CSS, React.js, Tailwind CSS, PHP, Python, JavaScript, and Ruby. Understanding of API integration using Axios or Fetch. Familiarity with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, and NoSQL databases. Ability to work independently in a remote setting.BenefitsOpportunity to build practical skills with modern backend technologies. Enhance your professional portfolio. Exposure to real-world development projects in a remote work environment.Internship DetailsDuration: Self-paced. Options of 15 days, 1 month, 2 months, 3 months, 4 months, or 6 months. Type: Unpaid.Application ProcessJoin us through online enrolment — simply submit your updated CV.
